novelty.text: To our knowledge, no public system gives an AI agent both a verifiable identity and a machine-enforced mandate that runs unchanged on a public chain and on a consortium chain.
novelty.reason: lead decision 16 Oct 2026 after the rival check (docs/evidence/rival-check.md): no counterexample found; the claim keeps "to our knowledge" and rests on the public-plus-consortium limb

items.note: tools/verify-py, independent of the TypeScript code

AllowedTargetsEnforcer.rule: The execution target must be one of the listed addresses

AllowedMethodsEnforcer.rule: The execution's 4-byte selector must be listed

ValueLteEnforcer.rule: Caps the native value of the execution; compiled as 0

AllowedCalldataEnforcer.rule: A byte range of the execution calldata must equal a sealed value

LimitedCallsEnforcer.rule: At most limit redemptions of this delegation

TimestampEnforcer.rule: Redemption only strictly after after and strictly before before (0 disables a bound)

NonceEnforcer.detail: the delegation is valid only while currentNonce[DM][delegator] equals the sealed nonce; incrementNonce(dm) from the account invalidates every delegation carrying the old nonce

ERC20TransferAmountEnforcer.rule: Cumulative cap on ERC-20 transfer amount for one token

ForbiddenTargetsEnforcer.rule: Keeps every T3 action out of reach of any delegation
ForbiddenTargetsEnforcer.detail: the target may never be the delegator itself (signer changes, upgrades, deposits), the DelegationManager (msg.sender), or any address listed in the terms

GlobalPauseEnforcer.detail: refuses every redemption while the account's kill switch is tripped (passkey pause, guardian, breaker watcher, dead-man timer), while the redeeming agent is halted by the supervisor in KillSwitchRegistry, or while the redeemer's passport exists and is not active

AgentLineageEnforcer.detail: the redeemer must be the wallet of an ACTIVE passport whose owner DID hash equals the DID sealed in the mandate, or the x402 facilitator pinned in the mandate

MandateBindingEnforcer.rule: Binds the delegation to a published, live mandate
MandateBindingEnforcer.detail: MandateRegistry.delegationOf(mandateHash) must equal the redeemed delegation's hash and isLive(mandateHash) must be true (status Live, inside [validFrom, validUntil])

JurisdictionEnforcer.detail: the paid asset must be one of the assets sealed for the mandate's jurisdiction profile; under the mainland profile only coin-free instruction rails (railKind() == 3) are permitted, whatever the asset list says

CoSignEnforcer.detail: above the T2 ceiling always reverts (T3); above the T1 threshold needs the user's own approval, checked as the delegator account's ERC-1271 signature (the passkey) over an Approval bound to this delegation, this exact execution, a nonce and an expiry

CategoryBudgetEnforcer.detail: per-period caps per spending category for one asset

ReserveFloorEnforcer.detail: after the whole redemption, the delegator's balanceOf of the asset must be at least the floor

VelocityEnforcer.rule: Limits how often and how much the agent moves per window
VelocityEnforcer.detail: at most maxCount payments (any asset) and at most maxOutflow of asset per fixed window of window seconds

SuitabilityEnforcer.detail: when money flows into a listed test investment product, the product's risk class (1 to 5, ProductRegistry) must not exceed the class sealed in the mandate

ReputationGateEnforcer.rule: When the beneficiary holds a passport, its ERC-8004 reputation summarised over the sealed client list (1 to 10 clients) must reach the sealed minimum

VetoTimelockEnforcer.rule: Scheduled payments with a veto window
VetoTimelockEnforcer.detail: the redeemer first announces the exact execution with schedule(dm, delegationHash, delegator, executionCallData); redemption succeeds only after window seconds, only by the address that scheduled it, only if not vetoed, and consumes the schedule

ZKMandateEnforcer.rule: Private, stateful mandate for ERC-20 payments

scales.name: Normalise
scales.what: NFKC; strips zero-width and bidi control characters

scales.name: Sentinel
scales.what: Calls the M1 injection classifier at SENTINEL_URL/sentinel (ONNX int8, ml/serving/app.py) with a 4 s timeout

scales.name: Quarantine
scales.what: Untrusted attachments (invoice, email, quote) go into an opaque HandleStore

scales.name: Ground
scales.what: Amount digits must appear in the user's words or come from an agreed reader field (then flagged)

scales.name: Policy
scales.what: A deterministic TypeScript mirror of the enforcers, decoding the same caveat bytes and reading the same on-chain counters (spentNow, usage, isPaused, isLive, lookup, isTrustedAgentWallet, productInfo, railKindOf, balances)

scales.name: Counterparty
scales.what: PayeeBook entry, passport and trusted-issuer attestation, a look-alike check against the payee book (same first and last four hex characters) and a small local demo sanctions list

scales.name: Simulate
scales.what: eth_call of DelegationManager.redeemDelegations from the agent address at the latest block

scales.name: Anomaly
scales.what: Rules over the receipt log: an amount above three times the largest past confirmed payment to the same payee (with at least two past payments) is flagged, and so is the first sweep into a product ("you decide once, later sweeps can run alone")

scales.name: Chain
scales.what: At redemption every caveat runs again
